title: Volkswagen AG - proposed acquisition of Porsche Automobil Holding SE & Porche AG

body_sections.Market definition: While the ACCC did not consider it necessary to reach a definitive view on market definition in this matter, the ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of national markets for the manufacture and supply of luxury motor vehicles.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC noted that the proposed acquisition would have a neutral effect on competition, since it represented an internal restructure following Porsche's acquisition of a 51% controlling interest in Volkswagen in 2008. The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the vast majority of luxury motor vehicles are imported into Australia; and - the merged entity would continue to be constrained by the various alternative suppliers of luxury motor vehicles in Australia.
